subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Ovulation, Corpus Luteum and the Two-Cell Theory

steps.tx: Release of the mature oocyte from the dominant follicle is **ovulation**. It follows the LH surge by about thirty six hours and occurs fourteen days before the next period, not always day fourteen. The fimbriae sweep the oocyte into the tube. The egg survives 12 to 24 hours, sperm up to five days, which sets the six day fertile window.
steps.say: Ovulation releases the oocyte thirty six hours after the LH surge.

steps.tx: The ruptured follicle transformed into a progesterone factory is the **corpus luteum**. It lives fourteen days unless rescued by hCG from implantation. Its progesterone converts the endometrium to secretory form. It secretes progesterone for about fourteen days, peaking near 25 nanograms per millilitre a week after ovulation.
steps.say: The corpus luteum makes progesterone for fourteen days unless hCG rescues it.

steps.tx: Theca cells making androgens that granulosa cells convert to oestrogen under separate gonadotropins is the **two-cell two-gonadotropin theory**. LH drives the first step, FSH the aromatisation. Neither cell alone makes oestrogen efficiently. Aromatase in granulosa cells is the enzyme step FSH controls, and its blockers are fertility drugs.
steps.say: The two-cell theory splits oestrogen synthesis between theca and granulosa under LH and FSH.

steps.tx: Midcycle pain from follicular rupture and peritoneal irritation is **mittelschmerz**. It localises to the ovulating side and lasts hours to a day. Basal temperature rises after, confirming ovulation retrospectively. Pain timing midway between periods, with a temperature rise the next day, separates it from appendicitis in most cycles.
steps.say: Mittelschmerz is midcycle pain from follicular rupture on the ovulating side.

steps.tx: Progesterone confirmation of ovulation uses a mid luteal blood level, termed **day 21 progesterone**. Timed seven days before expected menses, not literally day twenty one in long cycles. A raised level proves ovulation occurred. Saliva ferning and mucus stretch were the older bedside equivalents before hormone kits.
steps.say: Day 21 progesterone, timed seven days before menses, proves ovulation occurred.

steps.tx: The regressing corpus luteum leaving a white scar is the **corpus albicans**. Without hCG rescue, progesterone falls and menstruation follows. Repeated cycles stud the ovary with these scars. It appears as a small white scar and does not bleed; a corpus luteum cyst that does bleed can mimic ectopic pain.
steps.say: The corpus albicans is the white scar left after the corpus luteum regresses.

steps.tx: Failure of the follicle to rupture despite luteinisation, trapping the oocyte, is the **luteinised unruptured follicle**. Hormones look ovulatory while no egg is released. It is an occult cause of unexplained infertility. Non steroidal anti inflammatory drugs around ovulation can cause it, a reversible drug cause worth asking about.
steps.say: Luteinised unruptured follicle traps the oocyte despite ovulatory hormones.

steps.tx: Ovulation prediction kits detect urinary LH for intercourse timing in **fertility awareness**. Temperature confirms afterwards but cannot predict. Cervical mucus stretch and clarity herald the fertile window prospectively. Spinnbarkeit, mucus stretching over eight centimetres without breaking, marks peak fertility days.
steps.say: Urinary LH kits predict ovulation while temperature only confirms it afterwards.

steps.tx: Anovulatory cycles bleed irregularly because unopposed oestrogen outgrows its blood supply, called **anovulatory bleeding**. It dominates adolescence and perimenopause. Endometrial protection needs progestogen when prolonged. Protection with a levonorgestrel intrauterine system also treats the bleeding while contraception is provided for five years.
steps.say: Anovulatory bleeding follows unopposed oestrogen outgrowing its blood supply.
